title: Mussoorie Winter Line Carnival 2023
idea: I had to make a hill town festival feel like an invitation and not a government notice. I let folk musicians and dancers walk across a real Mussoorie cloudscape under a hand-lettered title.
alt: Brochure cover for the Mussoorie Winter Line Carnival 2023 with folk performers placed over a mountain view.

title: Demo Day, Spring Quarter 2026

title: ssam: Mother-of-Pearl App Icon
idea: I had to give a handwriting app a mark that felt Korean without using a flag or a letter. I drew the pen stroke as mother-of-pearl inlay on black lacquer, the way a jagae box is made.
alt: A black lacquer app icon with an iridescent mother-of-pearl emblem of a looping pen stroke over notebook lines.

title: Floron Exit Maps: The Way Out
idea: We had to show why a cooling gas brand should care about fire exits. One stairwell sign reads IN when the building is calm and OUT when it burns.
alt: A case film frame with an OUT sign in a burning stairwell and the words The Way Out.

title: Priyanka: A Dor Student
alt: A short story reel about a Dor Foundation student, with her portrait, college scenes and the Dor logo.

title: Weaving Dreams with Dor: Invitation
idea: I had to invite guests to our students’ send-off with the Governor as chief guest. I set it like a formal evening card in black and gold so the students’ day read as an occasion.
alt: A black and gold invitation to the Weaving Dreams with Dor event on 12 August 2023 in Dehradun.

title: Welcome to Weaving Dreams with Dor: Standee
idea: I had to greet guests at the door and explain what Dor does in four words. I put the four steps as line icons under an open sky.
alt: A tall standee with a blue sky, the Dor logo and four icons for Understand, Reflect, Engage and Collaborate.

title: India’s No. 1 Cooling Gas
idea: We had to open the film on the product without a pack shot feeling like an ad break. Three cylinders stand on teal under one plain claim.
alt: Three Floron refrigerant cylinders on a teal background under the line India’s No. 1 Cooling gas.

title: Tastes Like Home
idea: We had to sell an in-flight meal as comfort. A woman cooking at a home stove sits against Air India red with three words.
alt: A red banner with an illustrated woman in a white saree cooking and the line Tastes Like Home.

title: c0mpiled-16: 2 Days Left
idea: We had to count down to the hackathon without making three near identical posts. Each day gets one huge holographic numeral under the same masthead.
alt: A cream poster for the c0mpiled-16 hackathon with a large iridescent numeral 2 and the words Days Left.

title: Happy New Year
idea: I had to write a school’s New Year greeting that parents would read. It is set as the school’s own resolution with the bear mascot waving.
alt: A New Year post for Maple Bear school with gold lettering and the bear mascot.

title: Happy Lohri
idea: I had to make a festival greeting for a college in its own colours. The O of Lohri becomes the institute’s green ring and the fire sits above it.
alt: A navy Happy Lohri post for ITM with a bonfire illustration.

title: Ventota Retail: Logo
idea: I had to give a retail franchise company a mark of its own. V and R lock together inside an envelope-like box.
alt: A red and charcoal VR monogram in a square frame for Ventota Retail.
